'''Khomm''' was the native language of the [[Khommite/Legends|Khommite]] species from [[Khomm/Legends|Khomm]]. Most Khommites were fluent in both Khommite and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="TEGtPaM" />
